guards.issue: NARROWED 2026-07-28 -- STILL A GAP. Two legs closed, the decisive one did not. CLOSED: RunState.lose_hp (run.py:304-316) now clamps at 0 (no more negative HP) and runs the run-level death-prevention pass -- `_resolve_death` (run.py:318-345) walks the potion belt asking `should_die` and calls `after_preventing_death` on the preventer, the port of CreatureCmd.KillWithoutCheckingWinCondition (CreatureCmd.cs:489-571). FairyInABottle.should_die (potions.py:1310-1311) answers False so the Fairy IS selected as the preventer, but FairyInABottle.after_preventing_death (potions.py:1313-1316) still returns immediately when `self.combat is None`, so nothing heals, `_resolve_death` re-kills through its 10 recursions, and the player still ends DEAD with the Fairy still in the belt.
